companies.name: Moss
companies.originalOneLiner: Real-time semantic search for Conversational AI
companies.originalDescription: Moss is building the real-time semantic search runtime for conversational and multimodal AI. Our system enables voice agents, copilots, and chat interfaces to retrieve, reason, and respond in sub-10 ms, delivering the responsiveness that makes AI interactions feel truly natural. If you’ve ever built a conversational or voice AI product, you’ve felt the lag. That moment when an agent pauses and the illusion of intelligence breaks. The bottleneck is almost always retrieval. Each query hops across networks and databases, adding delay and cost. Moss eliminates that gap by keeping retrieval close to where the agent runs. Moss runs natively across browsers, mobile devices, and servers with an optimized vector index built in Rust and WebAssembly. It enables teams to build AI products that feel instant, contextual, and adaptive. The experiences that sustain engagement and unlock new kinds of interaction. For our customers, this translates into tangible business value: stronger user retention, higher conversion, and entirely new product categories made possible by real-time understanding. Moss is already powering production pilots across voice AI and developer platforms, achieving sub-10 ms retrieval and 70–90% token savings compared to traditional pipelines.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是对话式人工智能的实时语义搜索基础设施。想象你正在开发一个语音助手，用户刚说完一句话，系统却要等上几百毫秒才回应，那种停顿瞬间打破了对话的流畅感。Moss 把检索过程压缩到十毫秒以内，让智能体在浏览器、手机和服务器上都能快速找到相关信息。它用 Rust 和 WebAssembly 构建了一个优化的向量索引，让检索紧挨着智能体运行，省去了跨网络和数据库的延迟。如果你想让语音助手或聊天机器人反应得像真人一样快，这个方案值得关注，因为响应速度往往是体验好坏的关键。

companies.name: Vector Legal
companies.originalOneLiner: A premier AI-native law firm & legal operating system for Startups.
companies.originalDescription: A modern solution for Startup legal. Vector combines premier lawyers/paralegals (averaging 10+ years of Big Law experience) + custom-built AI, so our clients get world class startup legal service at a fraction of Big Law rates. See our client testimonials - https://www.vectorlegal.com/testimonials. Services: fundraise & priced rounds | customer contracts | international flips | complex formations | grow your team | agentic data rooms | e-signatures | cap table management | legal health checks | mergers & acquisitions | co-founder separations | dissolutions.
companies.story: 这是一家面向初创企业的人工智能原生律师事务所，同时也是一个法律操作系统。假如你是一家创业公司的创始人，正在准备新一轮融资，面对厚厚的条款清单和复杂的股权结构，你可能会感到头疼。Vector 把经验丰富的律师和定制的人工智能结合起来，处理融资、客户合同、国际架构、股权表管理等事务，收费却远低于传统大律所。它还能做数据室、电子签名和法律健康检查。对于预算有限但又需要专业法律支持的初创团队来说，这种模式可能改变游戏规则。

companies.name: Clicks Health
companies.originalOneLiner: AI agents for your healthcare back-office operations.
companies.originalDescription: Clicks Health builds AI agents that automate back-office operations for RCM companies and healthcare providers. Our agents work across EHRs, payer portals, desktop applications, and legacy systems, following existing processes, handling exceptions, and escalating when human judgment is needed. Backed by Y Combinator, Clicks helps teams improve accuracy, shorten turnaround times, and reduce operating costs, with SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliance built in.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是医疗后台运营的人工智能智能体。想象你是一家诊所的运营负责人，每天要处理大量的保险理赔、账单和病历记录，这些工作繁琐且容易出错。Clicks Health 的智能体可以自动操作电子病历系统、保险门户和遗留软件，按照现有流程处理例外情况，并在需要人类判断时升级给人工。它通过了 SOC 2 Type II 和 HIPAA 合规认证，意味着数据安全有保障。对于想降低成本、提高准确率的医疗机构来说，这套系统能减轻不少负担。

companies.name: Mbodi AI
companies.originalOneLiner: Industrial Robots that Learn and Operate Like Humans
companies.originalDescription: Teach robots new skills through natural language and run reliably in production in minutes. Mbodi combines generative AI and agent orchestration, turning everyday language and quick demos into precise, reliable robot actions for industrial automation.
companies.story: 这家公司专注于让工业机器人像人一样学习和操作。想象你是一个工厂的质检员，每天需要手动编程机器人去完成不同的分拣或装配任务，这既耗时又需要专业技能。Mbodi AI 让你可以用自然语言和快速演示来教机器人新技能，几分钟内就能在生产环境中可靠运行。它结合了生成式人工智能和智能体编排，把日常语言转化为精确的机器人动作。对于希望灵活调整生产线、应对多变任务的工厂来说，这能大大提升效率。

companies.name: Klarify
companies.originalOneLiner: AI Agent for Therapists
companies.originalDescription: Klarify handles every job a therapist does other than the therapy itself, from clinical notes and treatment plans to insurance claims and finding new clients. Therapists hold the world together. They also run businesses, file insurance claims, write letters, fill forms, supervise new grads, and do hours of paperwork every night. Practice management software has existed for decades. It records what therapists do. It can't actually do any of it. Klara is the AI at the heart of Klarify. She handles notes, treatment plans, clinical letters, insurance claims, between-session resources, supervision prep, and finding new clients. Nearly 8,300 therapists use Klarify today. Our mission is to empower therapists, not replace them. So they can focus on the one thing only a human can do. Be present with their client.
companies.story: 这是一家为心理治疗师打造人工智能助手的公司。假如你是一位心理咨询师，每天除了做咨询，还要花好几个小时写临床记录、制定治疗计划、处理保险理赔和寻找新客户。Klarify 的智能体 Klara 可以帮你处理这些文书工作，包括写笔记、治疗计划、临床信件、保险理赔、准备督导材料等。目前已有近八千三百名治疗师在使用。它不是为了取代治疗师，而是让你能把精力放在与来访者相处上，这或许是这个职业最需要的东西。

companies.name: Fort
companies.originalOneLiner: Strength Tracking Wearable
companies.originalDescription: Fort is a wearable that tracks strength training for people who care about longevity. Other wearables make you manually log every rep, set, and exercise, then provide unhelpful feedback or underestimate strength-related fatigue. We use heart rate and motion data to track your strength workouts for you, then provide thoughtful, actionable feedback that helps you achieve your goals.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是力量训练追踪的可穿戴设备。想象你是一个注重长期健康的健身爱好者，每次举铁都要手动记录组数和次数，而其他手环只能给出模糊的反馈，甚至低估你的疲劳程度。Fort 通过心率传感器和运动数据自动识别你的训练动作，并给出有针对性的建议，帮助你更好地达成目标。它不只是一个手机应用，而是把能力放进了腕带设备里，让你在训练时无需掏出手机就能获得数据反馈，这更符合实际锻炼场景。

companies.name: Bullet
companies.originalOneLiner: YC S26) – A Faster Coding Agent
companies.originalDescription: YC S26) – A Faster Coding Agent
companies.story: 这是来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次的一个编码智能体项目，定位是更快的编程助手。想象你是一个软件工程师，正在处理一个复杂的 bug，你希望智能体能快速理解代码库并给出修改建议。Bullet 的目标是让编码智能体在速度和效率上更进一步。虽然目前信息有限，但作为 YC 支持的创业公司，它可能代表了开发工具领域的新方向。对于开发者来说，更快的编码智能体意味着更少等待、更多产出，值得关注。

companies.name: Clay
companies.originalOneLiner: Data enrichment and go-to-market automation platform.
companies.originalDescription: Clay gives sales and growth teams a way to gather customer data, enrich leads, and build outbound workflows without stitching together many small tools.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是数据丰富化和市场推广自动化平台。想象你是一个销售主管，每天需要从各种渠道收集潜在客户的信息，手动整理并发送个性化邮件，这既繁琐又容易遗漏。Clay 提供了一个整合的工具，让你能自动抓取客户数据、丰富线索信息，并构建外呼流程，而不用拼接多个小工具。对于销售和增长团队来说，这能节省大量时间，让你专注于真正重要的沟通和转化。

companies.name: Lovable
companies.originalOneLiner: AI product builder for turning prompts into applications.
companies.originalDescription: Lovable lets people describe an app or product idea and generate working software faster, especially for early prototypes and small product teams.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是人工智能产品构建器，让用户通过描述想法来生成可用的软件。想象你是一个产品经理，有了一个新应用的点子，但写代码需要几周时间，而 Lovable 可以让你用自然语言描述需求，快速生成一个原型或最小可行产品。它特别适合早期原型验证和小型产品团队，能大幅缩短从想法到实现的周期。虽然它不是 YC 公司，但这类工具正在改变软件构建的方式，值得关注。

companies.name: Cognition
companies.originalOneLiner: AI software engineering agents.
companies.originalDescription: Cognition works on AI systems that can take on software engineering tasks, plan changes, use developer tools, and move beyond single code suggestions.
companies.story: 这家公司致力于开发能够承担软件工程任务的人工智能系统。想象你是一个工程负责人，面临一个大型代码重构项目，需要规划变更、使用各种开发工具，并确保不影响现有功能。Cognition 的人工智能可以理解任务、制定计划并执行，而不仅仅是给出代码建议。它超越了简单的代码补全，朝着更自主的编程智能体方向发展。对于希望提高开发效率的团队来说，这可能是一个重要的突破方向。

readings.title: Launch HN: Bullet (YC S26) – A Faster Coding Agent
readings.story: 写代码的人大概都经历过这样的时刻：一个任务明明不复杂，但工具反应慢，思路被打断，等它转完圈，你早忘了刚才要改哪里。于是大家总在找更快的助手。这篇讲的就是一个叫 Bullet 的编程代理，号称更快。它出现在 YC 的孵化名单里，又在 Hacker News 上被讨论，本身就说明很多人对“快”这件事有多在意。读的时候可以留意，作者是怎么定义“快”的，是响应速度，还是少问问题，或者别的什么。看他们怎么拆解这个目标，也许比结论更有意思。

readings.title: [AINews] SpaceXAI Grok 4.6 and Grok @Bot
readings.story: 如果你偶尔刷技术新闻，会发现人工智能的消息总是又密又快，今天这个模型，明天那个机器人，好像不跟上就落后了。这篇来自 Latent Space 的简报，讲的正是这类动态，标题里提到了 Grok 4.6 和一个叫 @Bot 的东西。它可能是在帮读者梳理发生了什么，以及背后谁在推动。读的时候不妨把它当成一个窗口，看看作者如何从一堆噪音里挑出重点，又如何判断哪条消息真正有分量。这样你就不只是被动接收，而是能自己掂量变化的分量。

readings.title: GitHub availability report: July 2026
readings.story: 很多团队把代码托管在 GitHub 上，平时没消息就是好消息，可一旦某天网站卡了或者提交失败，大家才会意识到，原来自己这么依赖它。这份报告是 GitHub 官方发布的七月可用性说明，属于那种平时没人看、出问题时才被翻出来的文档。但它其实值得提前读：你可以从中了解，一个大型平台如何定义“可用”，如何统计故障，又如何向用户交代。读的时候可以关注他们用了哪些指标，哪些事件被列出来，这能帮你理解，所谓稳定到底意味着什么。

companies.name: Rhizome AI
companies.location: New York City, NY, USA; Remote
companies.originalOneLiner: Agent Platform for Life Sciences
companies.originalDescription: It takes 500,000 days of office work to bring a drug to market. We want to make it 5. To get there, we need agents doing most of the work. Today, our research agent is the best way to know what the FDA thinks. Users ask a question and get an answer backed by up to 1,000 documents, where each statement has a citation. It’s the best because we have the best retrieval engine. We’ve tuned it on our life science-specific dataset, and we find what others miss. As more teams use Rhizome, we gain more data on what regulatory professionals actually need, which makes retrieval even better. This flywheel is how we become the retrieval engine that powers all human and agent work in life sciences. Chetan started his career as a research engineer, but quickly realized he enjoyed building more than research. He joined EvolutionaryScale as their sole founding product engineer, launching their developer-scientist platform and scaling to tens of thousands of users and billions of API calls. He was also #16 at Instabase helping banks with document processing, closing $7m as the technical closer. Agents can do magical things today, but most in life sciences only use them to edit emails. Agents are missing the context they need to 100x the number of drugs we can bring to market. Rhizome AI is focused on that critical problem.
companies.story: Rhizome AI 是一家为生命科学领域打造智能体平台的公司，专注于帮助药物研发和监管事务团队处理海量文档。想象你是一名监管事务分析师，正在准备一份提交给 FDA 的申请，需要查阅上千份文件来确认最新的审批要求。过去，这要耗费数周时间，而现在你只需向 Rhizome 的研究智能体提问，它就能从最多 1000 份文件中提取答案，并为每句话提供引用来源。它的检索引擎经过生命科学数据集的专门调优，能发现其他工具遗漏的信息。作为 YC 冬季 2026 批次的一员，团队目前正在招聘，虽然只有一人，但这款产品已经吸引了早期用户的关注。它之所以值得关注，是因为它把药物上市所需的海量办公室工作从 50 万天压缩到 5 天，这可能会彻底改变监管流程的效率。

companies.name: Valgo
companies.originalOneLiner: Insurance risk layer for physical AI
companies.originalDescription: Insurers struggle to price autonomous systems because the historical data simply doesn't exist. Your car insurance draws from over 30 billion claims records, but autonomous trucks and robots have nearly zero. Valgo is the risk quantification platform that closes that gap. We are building probabilistic models of routes, tasks, and environments from the bottom up. We output a simulated loss estimate that insurers need to price coverage. Valgo is the foundational layer that gives insurance providers confidence to properly price autonomy risk. Our team combines expertise in risk estimation for autonomy with deep experience in the insurance industry. Sydney and Robert are Stanford PhDs with leading expertise in safety of physical AI systems. Sydney wrote the textbook on validating safety-critical systems and teaches the course at Stanford. Robert spent 7 years at MIT Lincoln Laboratory on the core team that designed and validated an FAA-certified aircraft collision avoidance system, now a worldwide standard. Jon is a Sloan Fellow from the Stanford GSB and an actuary who spent over 12 years in insurance leadership and led over $5 billion in M&A as head of corporate development for one of the largest insurers in Asia-Pacific.
companies.story: Valgo 是一家为物理人工智能提供保险风险量化平台的公司，专注于解决自动驾驶卡车和机器人等自主系统的定价难题。想象你是一名保险公司的核保人，今天要为一支自动驾驶卡车车队报价，但你发现几乎没有历史事故数据可以参考，而传统汽车保险有超过 300 亿条理赔记录。Valgo 从零开始构建路线、任务和环境的概率模型，输出模拟损失估计，让你能够为自主系统定价。两位创始人是斯坦福博士，一位写过验证安全关键系统的教科书，另一位在 MIT 林肯实验室工作过七年。作为 YC 冬季 2026 批次项目，团队三人，目前没有招聘。它的价值在于填补了自主系统保险数据缺失的空白，为保险公司提供信心来承保这类新兴风险。

companies.name: Overshoot
companies.originalOneLiner: AI Infra for real-time vision applications
companies.originalDescription: Overshoot makes it easy for developers to build and run real-time vision applications. AI can see and understand the physical world. This unlocks new applications in physical security, safety, gaming, robotics and general consumer products. Soon, video agents will watch your home and your pet when you’re away. However, existing platforms make it painful for developers to build these real-time applications. Slow inference. Limited model availability. Break at scale. Overshoot solves this. Today, 300+ developers connect live video feeds to the largest collection of Vision Language Models with 3 lines of code. And get responses in less than 200ms. 10x faster than any existing inference platform. Zero infra headache. Our moat is focus. Image and Video are fundamentally different modalities from text. By focusing on them, we are able to make strong technical leaps from codec, streaming protocols to inference engines. Younes and Zakaria are cousins. Zakaria graduated top of his class at LSE and MIT, and later built low-latency high-throughput pricing systems (surge) at Uber and inference engines at Meta. He previously built and sold a software product and won several prominent AI hackathons. Younes was a founding engineer at Cosmonio (later acquired by Intel). He built a training and serving Computer Vision platform from scratch. He witnessed firsthand customers abandoning traditional Computer Vision because it lacked the “general” intelligence LLMs have today. Together we’ve shipped large-scale systems and know where they break.
companies.story: Overshoot 是一家为实时视觉应用提供人工智能基础设施的公司，让开发者能够轻松构建和运行视频理解应用。想象你是一名开发者，正在为一个家庭安全产品添加实时宠物监控功能，但现有的推理平台响应太慢，模型选择也有限。Overshoot 允许你用三行代码连接实时视频流，并在 200 毫秒内获得响应，速度比现有平台快十倍。它支持大量视觉语言模型，并且专注于视频和图像，不同于文本处理。作为 YC 冬季 2026 批次项目，团队五人，目前已有超过 300 名开发者使用。它之所以值得关注，是因为它解决了实时视频推理的瓶颈，为物理安全、游戏和机器人等应用打开了大门。

companies.name: Libra Robotics
companies.originalOneLiner: Multi-robot collaboration for harsh environments on Earth.
companies.originalDescription: We build collaborative robot squads for solar farm construction. High labor costs, labor shortages, and unpredictable productivity make infrastructure difficult to build in places that are remote, harsh, or empty. We are building robots to unlock places once considered too difficult to develop. Solar is our first proving ground, spanning utility-scale, commercial and industrial, community solar, agrivoltaic, and other projects. Unlike solutions that automate only one task, or even part of one, we cover the workflow after PV module pallets arrive on-site: transportation, installation, alignment, and fastening. Each robot has a specific role, and fleets can be configured based on each project’s cost and schedule requirements. Our robots operate autonomously with remote supervision. One person can supervise 4+ robots through a screen and an e-stop button, without being physically present or teleoperating them. Our robotic fleet has also been tested at night, paving the way for 24/7 operation. We work directly with EPCs through a Robotics-as-a-Service model, requiring no robot purchase or large upfront capital investment. We also work with racking and PV module manufacturers to certify compatibility and give customers confidence in deployment. Purpose-built hardware, multimodal sensing, and physical AI software help our robots handle real-world construction uncertainty.
companies.story: Libra Robotics 是一家为恶劣环境建造协作机器人队伍的公司，目前专注于太阳能发电厂的建设。想象你是一名太阳能项目施工经理，正在一个偏远的沙漠地带负责安装光伏板，但劳动力短缺且成本高昂，工期一再延误。Libra 的机器人团队覆盖从光伏板托盘到达现场后的运输、安装、对准和固定整个流程。每个机器人都有特定角色，一个操作员可以远程监督四台以上机器人。作为 YC 夏季 2026 批次项目，团队两人，目前没有招聘。它之所以值得关注，是因为它通过多机器人协作，解锁了那些被认为难以开发的地区，解决了基础设施建设的劳动力难题。

companies.name: Kinro
companies.originalOneLiner: Autonomous insurance brokerage for small businesses
companies.originalDescription: We are building the first autonomous insurance brokerage. We hit $1M in annual revenue building insurance workflows for brokers. Then we realized the bigger opportunity was replacing them. In the US, there are 36 million SMBs, and 77% are underinsured because distribution is broken. Brokers can’t serve low-premium SMBs profitably: a $2K policy takes almost as much work as a $20K one. Kinro changes that. Our AI agents handle the full broker workflow 24/7, from finding prospects to binding policies. In 3 weeks, we got licensed in 24 states and appointed by 10 carriers. Last week, our agents autonomously bound 9 policies. Before Kinro, Pierre was an AI researcher at DeepMind. Corentin was Chief Insurance Officer at an insurtech. Parth built ML systems at Zoox.
companies.story: Kinro 是一家为小企业提供自主保险经纪服务的公司，用人工智能代理处理从寻找客户到绑定保单的全部流程。想象你是一名小企业主，经营一家社区面包店，想买一份商业保险，但传统经纪人因为保费太低而不愿服务。Kinro 的人工智能代理 24/7 工作，在 3 周内获得了 24 个州的牌照，并与 10 家保险公司签约。团队三人，来自 DeepMind、保险科技和 Zoox，目前正在招聘。作为 YC 春季 2026 批次项目，它已经实现了 100 万美元的年收入，并自主绑定了 9 份保单。它之所以值得关注，是因为它瞄准了 77% 的美国小企业保险不足的问题，用自动化降低了服务成本。

companies.name: Perseus Defense
companies.originalOneLiner: America's Golden Dome for Drones
companies.originalDescription: Perseus Defense is building a mass-manufactured Counter UAS solution for the Department of Defense and Department of Homeland Security. Current solutions are one-to-one, too dangerous for use on U.S. soil, and orders of magntiude more expensive than the threats they defeat. Our self-guided missile platform is man-portable and multi-domain capable. It senses, engages, and eliminates threats with drastically reduced cost per engagement over existing kinetic solutions. Solving this critical national security problem requires understanding complex DoD needs along with actual rocket science including aerodynamics, guidance, navigation, control, and much more. Jason and Steve met at Penn State while they pursued their PhD and MS in aerospace engineering, respectively. Their past experiences designing space helicopters for NASA, making Boeing airliners land autonomously, controlling swarms of unmanned autonomous systems, teaching aerospace engineering at Stanford, winning multiple ONR and DOE engineering competitions, and founding an international drone competition makes them the perfect team to create transformative solutions protecting our service members. "If you build this, it will be mandatory equipment for every truck, boat, and convoy in the U.S. Military. We're talking thousands of units." - Former DoD Procurement Officer The White House just released Executive Order, "Unleashing American Drone Dominance" which adds billions of dollars, government support, and streamlined regulations to enable the development of our product. Traction: Jason and Steve used more than 100 end-user interviews across the DoD and DHS to shape the product to something of critical need to both boots on the ground and DoD purchasers. In 8 short weeks following a strict 2-week design-build-test cycle, the team has gone through 4 major guided missile iterations with over 30 live-fire flight tests. They were invited to Ft. Hood to present their platform to the 1st Cavalry Division, and also briefed the Pentagon and U.S. congressmen on current U.S. vulnerabilities to advanced drone technology. Perseus Defense is actively standing up cooperative research agreements with U.S. Army DEVCOM's Applied Research Laboratory, Aviation and Missile Center, Armaments Center, and High Performance Computing Modernization Program.
companies.story: Perseus Defense 是一家为国防部开发反无人机系统的公司，目标是制造大规模生产的自导导弹平台。想象你是一名军事指挥官，正在保护一个军事基地免受无人机袭击，但现有解决方案要么太贵，要么在国土上使用太危险。Perseus 的平台是便携式的，能感知、交战并消除威胁，每次交战的成本远低于现有动能武器。团队两人，毕业于宾夕法尼亚州立大学，有航空航天工程背景，曾参与 NASA 和波音项目。作为 YC 夏季 2025 批次项目，团队三人，目前正在招聘。它之所以值得关注，是因为它解决了无人机威胁的紧迫问题，提供了比现有方案便宜且安全的替代品。

companies.name: Locata
companies.originalOneLiner: AI Referral Automation for Primary Care Clinics
companies.originalDescription: Locata is an AI referral management platform for Primary Care. We deploy AI agents to automate every step of the referral process that back-office staff face daily, from submitting prior authorizations to broadcasting updates and following up with patients. This frees up staff to focus on patient care. Primary care back-offices are severely understaffed and overburdened by administrative work associated with referrals. Additionally, patients suffer navigating the complex referral process, which can have disastrous health effects if they don’t get the care they need. These factors point to a glaring gap in the system—where out of over 100 million specialist referrals issued annually in the US, only half are actually completed. Locata is tackling this problem head-on, saving administrative staff hours each week and ensuring that the referral process goes as smoothly as possible for patients and their providers. Alejandro and Josh met at Stanford where they graduated with BS degrees in Computer Science. Alejandro was a senior software engineer at Meta’s Reality Labs where he led development of several AI features for wearable products and prior to that conducted AI research at Stanford Medicine. Josh graduated with a masters in Computer Science, specializing in AI, before working as a software engineer at Google where he developed AI products that served over 1 billion users. Within two weeks of building our product, we signed a major regional health center and have saved them over 100 hours of work in our first month live.
companies.story: Locata 是一家为初级保健诊所提供人工智能转诊管理平台的公司，用智能体自动化转诊流程。想象你是一名诊所的后台工作人员，每天要处理大量转诊授权申请，还要跟进患者和专科医生，忙得不可开交。Locata 的智能体可以自动提交预授权、广播更新并随访患者，节省了行政人员每周数小时的工作时间。美国每年有超过 1 亿次专科转诊，但只有一半完成，Locata 旨在解决这个问题。作为 YC 夏季 2025 批次项目，团队四人，目前正在招聘。它之所以值得关注，是因为它减少了行政负担，确保患者及时获得所需护理。

companies.name: Harper
companies.originalOneLiner: AI-native commercial insurance brokerage
companies.originalDescription: At Harper, we are building a fully autonomous commercial insurance brokerage powered by AI. Our initial focus is on mid-sized businesses with complex insurance needs, but our vision is to eventually serve every business in the country. By leveraging AI to automate key workflows in the insurance process, we efficiently secure optimal coverage for each client's unique requirements at competitive prices and with rapid turnaround. Our AI system learns from the expertise of our brokers, accumulating not just knowledge but also the specific workflows, data, and capabilities that pave the way to full autonomy.
companies.story: Harper 是一家用人工智能驱动的商业保险经纪公司，专注于中型企业的复杂保险需求。想象你是一名制造企业的风险经理，正在为工厂寻找综合保险，但传统经纪流程繁琐且耗时。Harper 的人工智能系统学习经纪人的专业知识，自动化关键工作流程，快速获取最优保障。团队 25 人，来自 YC 冬季 2025 批次，目前正在招聘。它已经实现了商业保险的自主化，目标是服务全国所有企业。它之所以值得关注，是因为它用人工智能提升了保险经纪的效率，可能改变整个行业。

companies.name: Brilliant Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: Open AI glasses and lightweight wearable computing devices.
companies.originalDescription: Brilliant Labs makes AI glasses and developer-friendly wearable hardware that can bring camera, display, and assistant functions closer to everyday use.
companies.story: Brilliant Labs 是一家开发人工智能眼镜和可穿戴硬件的公司，产品面向开发者。想象你是一名开发者，正在构建一个增强现实应用，需要一款轻便、可编程的眼镜硬件。Brilliant Labs 的眼镜集成了摄像头、显示器和助手功能，并提供了开发者友好的接口。它不只是一个手机应用，而是把人工智能能力放进了眼镜这个随身设备里，让交互更自然。虽然来自智能硬件观察名单，没有具体批次或招聘信息，但它代表了可穿戴计算的一个方向。它之所以值得关注，是因为它推动了开放硬件和人工智能的结合，为开发者创造了新的可能性。

companies.name: Keet
companies.originalOneLiner: YC S24) – An app to create video courses on anything
companies.originalDescription: YC S24) – An app to create video courses on anything
companies.story: Keet 是一款来自 YC 夏季 2024 批次的应用，让用户可以创建关于任何主题的视频课程。想象你是一名专业摄影师，想在线分享你的技巧，但传统课程制作工具复杂且耗时。Keet 让你轻松录制和编辑视频，快速生成课程。它来自 Launch HN，团队人数未知，目前没有招聘。它之所以值得关注，是因为它降低了视频课程创作的门槛，让更多人能够分享知识和技能。

readings.title: Launch HN: Discovered Materials (YC P26) – AI agents to discover new materials
readings.story: 在实验室里，研究人员常常要翻遍论文和数据库，才能找到一种可能的新材料，这个过程既慢又贵。现在有人想把 人工智能 智能体用在这件事上，让机器自己去筛选和提出候选材料。这篇文章来自 YC 孵化的新公司，讲的就是他们如何用 人工智能 代理来加速材料发现。对于关注科研工具或 人工智能 应用的人来说，这篇值得一看。读的时候可以留意，他们是怎么把科研人员的需求拆解成 人工智能 能完成的任务，以及他们如何判断 人工智能 给出的建议是否靠谱。

readings.title: [AINews] How to steal a Reasoning Trace
readings.story: 当 人工智能 模型在回答问题时，它会先在心里默默推理一番，这个过程叫“推理轨迹”。但你知道吗，这个轨迹可能被别人偷走？这篇来自 Latent Space 的文章讨论的正是这种安全隐患。随着 人工智能 被用在更多重要场景，保护模型的内部思考过程变得越来越关键。这篇文章不是讲枯燥的技术细节，而是用实例说明攻击者可能如何下手。读的时候，你可以关注作者如何解释这种攻击的原理，以及他们提出了哪些防御思路。

readings.title: India’s Yulu raises $93M as quick-commerce boom fuels e-bike demand
readings.story: 在印度，外卖和电商越来越快，人们习惯了半小时收货，这背后需要大量电动车送货。Yulu 这家公司就做共享电动车生意，刚拿到 9300 万美元融资。这看起来只是一笔投资新闻，但它反映了快速商业时代对交通方式的新需求。如果你好奇共享出行和即时配送怎么结合，这篇文章值得读。读的时候，可以想想为什么资本看好这个方向，以及它会给城市交通带来什么变化。

companies.name: Fabraix
companies.originalOneLiner: The world's frontier hacker for AI agents.
companies.originalDescription: Fabraix builds state-of-the-art AI red-teaming agents that continuously detect security vulnerabilities in customer-facing AI. Our product, Nyx, has already found vulnerabilities in agents at dozens of Fortune 500 companies. On AgentHarm, the leading benchmark for offensive AI security, Nyx achieved a 78% attack success rate, compared with 67% for GPT-5.6 Sol. AI agents can change more often than teams can test them. A new model, prompt, tool, permission, or data source can change what an agent does, even when the application code stays the same. And AI is also increasing how much software companies produce and how often it changes. We built Nyx to automate the work required to red-team AI agents. It is multi modal by design and interacts with the target indirectly through controlled replicas of SaaS products and websites that we maintain, placing malicious payloads in webpages, documents, files, messages, and tool outputs to test how an agent behaves under different conditions. Nyx often finds its first vulnerability within minutes or hours rather than days or weeks. Because the work is fully automated, companies can repeat the test with every change and at a much lower cost than what a 7-figure red-teaming (and point-in-time) engagement would require. We're also the team behind ACE (Adversarial Cost to Exploit), a benchmark that measures AI security in terms of how much it costs attackers to break an AI system; providing a game-theoretic framework to understand how motivated a rational attacker would be in exploiting the system.
companies.story: 这是做人工智能安全测试的公司，专注为智能体找漏洞。假如你是某家大型银行的首席信息安全官，每天最头疼的就是新上线的客服智能体可能被恶意提示词骗走客户数据。Fabraix 的 Nyx 系统能自动模拟攻击，不断尝试突破智能体的防护，它已经在一家知名安全基准测试里达到 78% 的攻击成功率，比目前最强的模型还高。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队只有两人，但产品已在多家世界五百强公司里发现过真实漏洞。

companies.name: Vendo
companies.originalOneLiner: Let your users build their own features on top of your product
companies.originalDescription: Vendo is the customization layer that lets your users build their own features and micro-apps directly on top of your product. Rather than waiting on an ever-growing feature backlog, your users can personalize the product to exactly how they work, create their own automations, and integrate hundreds of external tools, all without your team writing a line of code. Everything runs on your existing API, renders natively in your own theme and components, and executes inside secure sandboxes within your existing security guardrails, so your source code is never touched. Companies can plug Vendo into an agent they already have, or deploy a production-ready agent complete with the ability to take actions in the product, generate UI, and draw on a built-in knowledge base. Vendo is open source and installs with a single command, and we work closely with teams to get it running for their product.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是让用户自己搭建功能的定制层。想象你是一个 SaaS 产品负责人，客户天天提需求，开发团队忙不过来，你希望用户能自己动手。Vendo 就让你把产品开放出去，用户在你的接口上自己写小程序、做自动化、连外部工具，你的代码完全不动。它开源，一条命令就能装好，还支持你现有的智能体，能直接在界面里生成新功能。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队两人，正在寻找早期合作伙伴。

companies.name: Capitol AI
companies.originalOneLiner: Capitol: the sovereign operating system for intelligence.
companies.originalDescription: Capitol AI is building a sovereign operating system for intelligence, designed for regulated, high-stakes institutions such as professional services firms, financial services, and government agencies. These organizations are overwhelmed by data and experimenting with generic AI tools that lack auditability, repeatability, and secure deployment. As a result, critical decisions are increasingly shaped by systems they do not fully control. Capitol runs entirely inside enterprise infrastructure and transforms proprietary data into structured, decision-grade artifacts such as due diligence reports, regulatory documentation, and executive intelligence. The platform is model-agnostic, fully auditable, and operates with no data egress, giving institutions durable control over their data, workflows, and standards.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是给高监管行业用的人工智能操作系统。假如你是政府机构的分析师，每天要处理大量机密文件，又要用人工智能辅助决策，但市面上的工具都不敢用，怕数据泄露。Capitol 可以完全运行在你的内部网络里，把数据变成尽职调查报告、监管文件这类可审计的成果。它不依赖特定模型，全程可追溯，数据不出门。公司来自 YC 夏季 2024 批次，团队十一人，正在招聘，已经服务专业服务、金融和政府客户。

companies.name: Toothy AI
companies.originalOneLiner: AI for insurance verification & billing at dental clinics
companies.originalDescription: We’re Toothy.ai. We’re building AI agents for dental practices that handle everything related to patient insurance. The average dental clinic spends over 160 hours a month on insurance tasks like verifying patient policies, billing, and claims processing. Our AI agents automate this entire workflow—including making insurance calls with voice AI—saving clinics time, reducing costs, and ensuring faster reimbursements.
companies.story: 这是做牙科诊所保险自动化的人工智能公司。想象你是一家牙科诊所的运营经理，每天要花大量时间打电话核实患者保险、提交理赔申请，忙得焦头烂额。Toothy AI 的智能体可以替你完成这些事，包括用语音电话跟保险公司沟通，自动处理账单和理赔。这家公司来自 YC 冬季 2025 批次，团队十五人，正在招聘，他们的产品已经在很多诊所里用，省下不少时间。

companies.name: Denta
companies.originalOneLiner: The dental practice that runs itself
companies.originalDescription: Denta is the practice management platform that puts dental practices on autopilot. When a dentist starts a new practice, instead of finding an accounting firm, hiring two front desk workers, and then spending their nights posting insurance payments, they use Denta. I started Denta to help operate my Dad's 10 practices in Iowa. In supporting those, I realized the most painful part was both people and agents having messy access to fragmented data. So I solved for that and now spend my time automating work for dentists!
companies.story: 这是做牙科诊所管理平台的公司，目标是让诊所自动运转。假如你是一位刚开诊所的牙医，你不想请会计、不想雇前台，更不想晚上自己录入保险付款。Denta 可以帮你处理这些杂事，把财务、保险、预约都管起来。创始人是因为帮父亲管理十家诊所，发现数据太分散才做了这个产品。公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，目前只有创始人一人，但已经开始帮牙医们省心了。

companies.name: Zolvo
companies.originalOneLiner: AI Back-Office Automation for Commercial Lenders
companies.originalDescription: Commercial lenders manage billions in assets on legacy software and manual workflows, their systems live on people’s heads like its the 90s. Zolvo replaces the entire back office with AI: automated data ingestion, invoice reconciliation, collections outreach, and funder monitoring. Our clients go live in weeks and eliminate hours of daily manual work per operator, allowing teams to only handle exceptions. We're building the future of commercial lending.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是商业贷款后台自动化。想象你是一家贷款机构的风控分析师，每天要手工核对发票、整理借款人资料，系统老得像是上个世纪的。Zolvo 用人工智能把数据输入、发票核对、催收、监控都自动化了，你只需要处理异常情况。它上线很快，能省下每天几小时的重复劳动。这家公司来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队三人，正瞄准商业贷款这个老旧的行业。

companies.name: Illume Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: 24/7 Personal Health & Longevity Companion
companies.originalDescription: Illume is a 24/7 AI personal health & longevity companion that connects your wearables, blood panels, and genomic data to text you personalized and actionable insights. We pull in your health data and fuse it into one secure model. You get daily text updates on what changed, what it means, and what to do next; conversational health Q&A like "What should I do to improve my bloodwork?"; cross-data trend detection that catches patterns individual platforms miss; and a full platform to dig deeper, explore your health data, and text your Illume agent anytime. We're 3 MIT grads & friends, with experience at Windsurf, MIT CSAIL, Eli Lilly, & the Broad Institute.
companies.story: 这是做个人健康与长寿陪伴的公司。想象你是一个注重健康的人，手上有智能手表、血检报告和基因数据，但没人帮你把信息串起来。Illume 会把你的数据整合成一个安全模型，每天发短信告诉你身体有什么变化、该怎么调整，你还能直接问它问题，比如怎么改善血液指标。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，三个创始人都是麻省理工毕业生，在知名科技和医药公司待过。

companies.name: Prototyping.io
companies.originalOneLiner: Autonomous manufacturing for mechanical parts
companies.originalDescription: Prototyping.io turns CAD designs into real mechanical parts through an AI-driven manufacturing system. We analyze designs for manufacturability and automate production workflows to deliver high-quality parts faster and at lower cost.
companies.story: 这是做机械零件自动化制造的公司。假如你是一个产品设计工程师，刚画好一个零件的 CAD 图纸，想快速打样，但传统工厂报价高、周期长。Prototyping.io 的人工智能系统会分析你的设计能不能造，然后自动安排生产，让你更快拿到实物，成本也更低。这家公司来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队两人，正在把制造业的自动化往前推。

companies.name: Plaud
companies.originalOneLiner: AI voice recorder hardware for meetings, calls, and personal notes.
companies.originalDescription: Plaud makes small recording devices and companion software that turn meetings, calls, and spoken thoughts into organized notes and summaries.
companies.story: 这是做人工智能录音硬件的公司。想象你是一个会议很多的咨询顾问，每天要开好几个会，根本记不住谁说了什么。Plaud 的小设备可以别在衣领上，或者放在桌上，它会把对话录下来，自动转成文字，并生成摘要和待办。它不只是一个手机应用，因为录音需要靠近声音源，而且设备上有专门的降噪芯片，比手机录音更清晰，也不占用手机。这家公司来自智能硬件观察名单，目前还没有更多公开信息。

companies.name: Stoa Markets
companies.originalOneLiner: YC S26) – A Marketplace for GPUs and AI Servers
companies.originalDescription: YC S26) – A Marketplace for GPUs and AI Servers
companies.story: 这是做 GPU 和人工智能服务器交易市场的公司。假如你是一个人工智能初创公司的工程负责人，想买显卡训练模型，但供应商报价不透明，交期也不确定。Stoa Markets 就像一个交易所，把算力买卖双方聚在一起，让价格更透明，交易更顺畅。这家公司通过 Launch HN 发布，来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，但团队规模和更多细节还没有公开。

readings.story: 你可能见过这样的场景：团队里有人疯狂追求某个指标，比如让模型输出更长、更花哨，以为这样就能让产品显得更有价值。但你心里隐约觉得，用户其实并不买账。这篇文章就是来戳破这种错觉的。它来自 Stack Overflow 的博客，讨论的是我们把注意力放在错误的地方，把表面的“优化”当成了真正的价值创造。读的时候，不妨想想你自己的产品里，有哪些指标是被过度追逐的，而作者是怎么区分表面功夫和真实价值的。

readings.title: AI Slop Backlash Is Starting to Change Platform Policy
readings.story: 最近你在刷社交媒体时，是不是开始觉得有些内容看起来像是由 人工智能 批量生成的，空洞又重复？这种“人工智能 垃圾”越来越多，以至于平台开始修改规则来应对。这篇文章来自 Hacker News 的讨论，标题说“人工智能 垃圾的反击正在改变平台政策”。它之所以值得关注，是因为它可能预示着我们日常看到的内容会如何变化。读的时候，可以留意一下，平台是打算用算法筛选，还是用人工审核，或者干脆让用户自己选择。

readings.title: [AINews] Muse Glimmer and Spark: Open Weights return Personal Superintelligence promise
readings.story: 假设你正打算给自己的工作流引入一个 人工智能 助手，希望它能帮你处理邮件、写报告，甚至规划日程。这时你听说有个新模型，号称能提供“个人超级智能”，而且权重开放，可以自己部署。这篇文章来自 Latent Space，就在讨论这类新发布。它之所以值得一读，是因为它可能帮你判断，这些承诺是否靠谱，以及开放权重到底意味着什么。读的时候，可以关注作者是怎么分析模型能力的，以及他如何看待这些新工具对普通用户的影响。

companies.name: Coasty
companies.originalOneLiner: The computer-use agent that doesn't break on real software. We will…
companies.originalDescription: Coasty is a computer use agent that does real work inside softwares, companies already run. New web apps, old desktop tools, the legacy systems nobody wants to touch. You hand it a workflow and it owns the outcome. Most agents demo well and break the moment they hit real software. They get 18 steps out of 20 right, misclick once, and everything after is garbage. Coasty catches when it goes off track and fixes itself mid-task instead of starting over. It handles the messy parts, benchmarks never show. Permission dialogs, surprise pop-ups, a modal that steals focus, a page that loads slow. When a vendor pushes an overnight update and moves half the menus, brittle scripts break by morning. Coasty reads the screen instead of recording clicks, so it adapts and keeps going. It also checks its own output and leaves a time-stamped trail you can replay. We won't pretend it gets every task right. Nothing automating this work does. What matters is what happens when something breaks. It catches the mistake, fixes what it can, and flags what it can't so a person can step in. Nothing fails quietly. That's what lets a team trust it on the work where a silent error gets someone fired. We scored 82% on OSWorld, which puts us among the most reliable agents out there. Reliability is the whole product, not a feature.
companies.story: Coasty 是一家做计算机使用智能体的公司，专门让软件自动化在真实业务里真正跑起来。想象你是一家公司的运营负责人，每天要处理一堆老旧的内部系统，比如十几年前的桌面工具和没人敢碰的遗留系统。你过去试过自动化工具，但它们总是在关键时刻出错：点错一次按钮，后面全乱套。Coasty 能自己发现跑偏并当场修正，不用从头再来。它靠读屏幕而不是记录点击，所以即使软件半夜更新了界面，它也能适应。它还会检查自己的输出，留下可回放的时间戳记录。这家公司来自 YC 夏季批次，团队只有两个人，但解决的是自动化最头疼的稳定性问题。

companies.name: Kilvin
companies.originalOneLiner: Custom software for non-technical teams.
companies.originalDescription: Kilvin is an AI-native agency that builds custom software solutions for non-technical teams. With AI, the future of software is democratized. Every team deserves tools built exactly for them, not off-the-shelf SaaS products they need to adapt to. Kilvin makes it a reality, delivering a private, secure workspace of custom applications, built around your workflows and ready in days, not months. No engineers needed on your side. Just software that fits exactly how you work.
companies.story: Kilvin 是一家用人工智能为不懂技术的团队定制软件的公司。假如你是一个市场部门的主管，你需要的工具总是和现成的软件对不上，要么功能太多，要么缺关键功能。Kilvin 能在几天内给你做出一个完全贴合你工作流程的定制应用，而不是让你去适应通用产品。你不需要自己养工程师，他们负责全部技术。这些应用放在一个私密又安全的工作空间里，专门按你的方式来。这家公司来自 YC 秋季批次，正在招聘，团队只有三个人，但他们的思路是让每个团队都拥有为自己量身打造的软件。

companies.name: Sourcebot
companies.originalOneLiner: Helping humans and AI agents understand massive codebases
companies.originalDescription: Sourcebot is an open source code understanding platform for massive codebases. We’re used by thousands of engineers in some of the largest companies in the world, including NVIDIA, Red Hat, Wikimedia, and Arista Networks. Understanding code, not writing it, is the primary bottleneck for large engineering teams. For developers, this means onboarding onto complex codebases faster. For AI agents, it means getting the necessary code context to minimize hallucinations and maximize cohesion within the wider codebase. Sourcebot solves this by giving developers and AI agents the ability to regex search across millions of lines of code instantly, as well as ask questions across thousands of repos using any flagship reasoning model. Being open source and on-prem, we can get deployed in enterprises within minutes before other tools even get approval. We met a decade ago at McGill University and have been building together full time for over 2 years. We’ve personally felt the pain of understanding large codebases while working at Microsoft, EA, Ubisoft, Google, and Meta.
companies.story: Sourcebot 是一个开源的代码理解平台，专门帮助开发者和智能体看懂庞大的代码库。想象你刚加入一家大公司当工程师，面对几百万行代码，光搞清楚结构就要花好几周。Sourcebot 让你能瞬间用正则搜索这些代码，还能用推理模型跨几千个仓库提问，大大加快上手速度。对人工智能智能体来说，它提供必要的代码上下文，减少胡编乱造。它支持本地部署，几分钟就能装好，不用等漫长的审批。这家公司来自 YC 秋季批次，正在招聘，团队三人，已经被英伟达、红帽等大公司使用。

companies.name: Amera
companies.originalOneLiner: Automating claims processing workflows for health insurance payers.
companies.originalDescription: Amera automates claims processing for health insurance payers. We turn messy claim inputs (PDFs, bills, receipts, EDI and non-standard submissions) into structured data that plugs into existing systems. This cuts manual entry and exception handling, speeding up operations and reducing cost. We are already working with payers / plan administrators representing ~100k members, giving them access to more affordable care options.
companies.story: Amera 做的是健康保险理赔流程的自动化。想象你是一家保险公司的理赔处理员，每天要面对一堆乱七八糟的理赔材料：PDF、账单、收据，还有各种非标准格式。Amera 把这些乱七八糟的输入变成结构化数据，直接接入你现有的系统，省掉手动录入和异常处理。这样理赔更快，成本更低。这家公司来自 YC 秋季批次，团队有十二个人，已经和覆盖约十万会员的支付方合作，让更多人能负担得起医疗服务。

companies.name: Unifold
companies.originalOneLiner: Multi-chain deposit and payment infrastructure
companies.originalDescription: Launch crypto deposits in minutes. Unifold is a developer-first API + SDK that makes it easy for any app to accept on-chain deposits – across any chain and token – with less than 10 lines of code. We handle the full deposit flow so teams can ship faster and give users a smooth experience that actually works. If you’re building a consumer-facing on-chain product and want best-in-class deposits (or want to support more chains fast), we’d love to work with you.
companies.story: Unifold 做的是多链存款和支付基础设施。假如你是一个正在开发消费级链上应用的创业者，最头疼的就是让用户能方便地存钱进来。Unifold 提供开发者优先的接口和软件开发工具包，你用不到十行代码就能接入，支持任何链和代币。它处理整个存款流程，让你的团队能更快上线，用户体验也更顺畅。这家公司来自 YC 冬季批次，团队三人，专门解决链上应用最关键的入门问题。

companies.name: Autumn Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: Datadog for industrial robots
companies.originalDescription: Autumn Labs delivers a developer-friendly platform for monitoring and managing modern manufacturing lines. Seamlessly integrating with robotic stations—automated test stations, robotic assembly cells, and industrial arms—it ensures full traceability, live data monitoring, and secure data transport. We prioritize streamlining factory operations, boosting production quality, and preventing supply chain disruptions, all while offering an effortless onboarding experience for engineers and manufacturers.
companies.story: Autumn Labs 做的是工业机器人的监控平台，有点像工业机器人的数据中心。想象你是一个工厂的运营经理，负责一条自动化装配线，上面有测试站和机械臂。你过去很难实时看到每台机器的状态，出了问题也不知道是哪一步。Autumn Labs 能无缝接入这些机器人站，提供完整追踪、实时数据监控和安全的数据传输。它帮你简化工厂运营，提高生产质量，防止供应链中断，而且工程师很容易上手。这家公司来自 YC 夏季批次，团队三人，专注让现代制造更透明。

companies.name: Taiga
companies.originalOneLiner: Autonomous medical billing
companies.originalDescription: Taiga automates medical billing for doctor's offices. A doctor uploads their visit data, our AI figures out the right billing codes, checks the claim for errors, and submits it to insurance, dealing with any denials. Faster billing, fewer rejected claims, less busywork. We're Nanda and Adam, friends since 3rd grade. Both of our parents are doctors with their own practices, and billing was always a source of stress and lost revenue for them. We want providers to treat patients while we handle the rest.
companies.story: Taiga 做的是医疗账单的自动化处理。想象你是一个私人诊所的医生，每天看完病人还要花大量时间整理账单，编码、检查、提交保险，被拒了还得重新处理。Taiga 让你上传就诊数据，它的人工智能自动搞定编码、查错、提交，并处理拒赔。这样账单更快，拒赔更少，你也能少做点文书工作。这家公司来自 YC 春季批次，团队两人，创始人的父母都是开诊所的医生，他们深知账单带来的压力和收入损失。

companies.name: Discovered Materials
companies.originalOneLiner: AI scientists to discover materials for the semiconductor industry.
companies.originalDescription: We use AI to discover new materials for the semiconductor industry - specifically datacenters and fabs. Finding novel materials today takes 10+ years of lab work. We aim to compress that timeline to months, using a swarm of AI agents. Akash completed his PhD at Stanford on material discovery for semiconductors. The materials he discovered for nanoscale interconnects have been adopted into the roadmaps of Intel and TSMC. Advaith was the founding applied scientist at Persona AI (acquired by Luma Labs), where he built long horizon autonomous agents for major telecom and crypto companies. Power consumption and heat release from AI chips is doubling every year. The semiconductor industry needs new materials to keep this exponential going - Discovered Materials will help find them.
companies.story: Discovered Materials 用人工智能为半导体行业发现新材料。想象你是一个芯片制造厂的工艺工程师，负责寻找新的材料来解决芯片发热和功耗问题。传统方法要花十年以上的实验室工作，而这家公司用一群人工智能智能体把时间压缩到几个月。他们特别关注数据中心和晶圆厂的需求。创始人之一在斯坦福完成了半导体材料博士，他发现的材料已经被英特尔和台积电采用。这家公司来自 YC 春季批次，正在招聘，团队两人，目标是解决人工智能芯片功耗翻倍带来的材料瓶颈。

companies.name: Whoop
companies.originalOneLiner: Wearable health and performance tracking hardware.
companies.originalDescription: Whoop makes a wearable that tracks recovery, sleep, strain, and health signals, then turns that data into coaching for athletes and everyday users.
companies.story: Whoop 做的是可穿戴健康追踪硬件，专门监测恢复、睡眠、压力和心率等信号，然后把这些数据变成训练建议。想象你是一个认真训练的运动员，每天醒来最想知道身体恢复得怎么样，该练还是该歇。Whoop 戴在手腕上，不像手机应用那样只靠你手动输入，它能自动持续监测，把数据变成个性化的恢复指导。它不只是一个手机应用，而是把传感器和算法放进随身设备里，让你在训练和日常生活中都能实时了解自己的身体状态。

companies.name: Sierra
companies.originalOneLiner: AI agents for customer service and enterprise workflows.
companies.originalDescription: Sierra helps companies build customer-facing AI agents that can answer questions, take actions, and connect to business systems without acting like a generic chatbot.
companies.story: Sierra 帮企业构建面向客户的智能体，这些智能体可以回答问题、执行操作，还能连接企业系统，而不是像普通聊天机器人那样只会说套话。想象你是一家电商公司的客服主管，每天要处理大量重复咨询，还要协调退款和订单修改。Sierra 的智能体能理解客户意图，直接调用后端系统完成操作，并且语气自然。它来自非 YC 渠道，但值得关注的是，它把人工智能从聊天提升到真正干活的层面，让客服从繁琐事务中解放出来。

readings.title: Show HN: Lector, a FOSS self-hosted language reader (with a cloud option)
readings.story: 很多人想学一门新语言，但找材料总让人头疼。网上的文章要么太难，要么太简单，要么没有注释。于是有人自己动手做了个工具，叫 Lector，可以自己托管，也有云服务。它出现在 Hacker News 上，被大家讨论，说明这不是一个人的需求，而是很多自学者的共同痛点。读这篇的时候，可以留意作者是怎么设计阅读流程的，比如怎么处理生词、怎么控制难度，这些细节往往比工具本身更有启发。

readings.title: Embattled hedge fund Situational Awareness invests $400M in chip startup Source Foundry
readings.story: 芯片行业一直烧钱，但最近一笔投资特别引人注目：一家叫 Situational Awareness 的对冲基金，投了 4 亿美元给芯片初创公司 Source Foundry。这家基金之前还深陷麻烦，现在却大手笔押注，让人好奇背后的逻辑。可能是看好某个新技术方向，也可能是行业格局要变。读这篇报道时，不妨想想，为什么是现在，为什么是这家公司，以及这笔钱会怎么影响整个产业链。

readings.title: Atlassian Just Deleted Loom’s Free Creator Seats. They Were Also Loom’s Distribution.
readings.story: 如果你用过 Loom 录屏，最近可能发现免费版不能用了。原来 Atlassian 把免费名额删了，而这些名额恰恰是 Loom 拉新用户的渠道。这就像一家店突然把试吃撤了，顾客还会来吗？SaaStr 这篇文章分析了这个决定背后的逻辑，以及它对 Loom 未来用户增长的影响。读的时候，可以思考一个产品如何平衡免费和付费，以及失去免费入口后，它还能靠什么吸引新用户。

companies.name: Armature
companies.originalOneLiner: Improve how users experience your product through AI Agents
companies.originalDescription: Armature helps companies monitor, analyze, and optimize how AI agents experience their products. We start with Product Analytics: user sessions on your Claude Connector, ChatGPT App or MCP live inside their AI client, not your UI. Armature captures and shows you what users ask, what agents think and how they use your product. Then, we provide automated evals infrastructure: run complex sessions against your MCPs/CLIs across all major harnesses and models to catch broken workflows before your users do. Finally, our MCP lets your internal coding agents plug into Armature to autonomously fix your product's AX based on our run data. The next step is to provide the foundational infrastructure for the Agent Experience, powering agent-native revenue, lifecycle marketing, and customer support for the next generation of software.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是人工智能时代的产品分析工具，帮助公司理解用户如何与他们的智能体产品互动。想象你是一个产品经理，你的用户通过Claude Code或ChatGPT这样的智能体来使用你的产品，你完全看不到他们在智能体界面里做了什么，不知道他们问了什么、智能体怎么思考、有没有卡住。Armature能捕捉这些会话，让你看到用户真实的使用过程，还提供自动评测基础设施，在用户遇到问题之前就发现坏掉的工作流。更妙的是，它的接口能让你们内部的编码智能体根据运行数据自动修复产品体验。这家公司来自YC春季2026批次，团队三人，虽然还在早期，但它瞄准的是智能体体验这个全新领域，值得关注。

companies.name: Dench.com
companies.originalOneLiner: Workspace for your AI Agents, Build any Workflow.
companies.originalDescription: Dench: AI CRM + Full-Service Deployment Most CRMs sell you software and hand you a 200-page setup guide. Dench is different. We're the only CRM that ships with an embedded team: we migrate your data, build your object schema, configure your integrations, train your people, and deploy AI agents that keep your pipeline clean without a Salesforce developer, a RevOps contractor, or a six-month implementation project. From day one, our team works inside your stack. We pull your existing data out of HubSpot, Salesforce, or whatever spreadsheet graveyard you're currently using, and rebuild it properly in Dench. Custom objects, custom fields, automation rules, integration config across Gmail, Slack, Notion, GitHub, LinkedIn, and 50+ other tools. Everything set up the way your business actually works, not the way a generic CRM template assumes it does. Then we train your team. Not a one-hour Zoom and a PDF. Real sessions that build CRM discipline: how to log activity consistently, how to keep data clean, how to use AI agents to do the repetitive work so your reps spend time selling instead of updating fields. Quarterly business reviews keep the system evolving as your pipeline grows. The AI layer is what makes it permanent. Dench agents enrich leads automatically, move deals through stages based on real signals, draft outreach, log interactions, and flag hygiene issues before they compound. Your CRM stays accurate without someone babysitting it. No implementation consultant invoice. No dedicated Salesforce admin headcount. No duct-taped automation stack. One engagement, everything included, starting at $1,500/month.
companies.story: 这是一家做人工智能客户关系管理的公司，但它的特别之处在于提供全服务部署。大多数客户关系管理系统卖给你软件后，丢给你一本两百页的安装指南，让你自己折腾。想象你是一个销售主管，公司用的是Salesforce或HubSpot，但数据一团糟，自动化规则没配好，团队成员不会用。Dench会派一个嵌入式团队帮你迁移数据、搭建对象结构、配置集成，还训练你的员工，甚至部署智能体来保持销售管道干净。整个过程不需要你请Salesforce开发人员或咨询顾问，也不用等六个月。这家公司来自YC夏季2024批次，目前团队六人，正在招聘，而且它把开源和人工智能结合，让客户关系管理变得真正可用。

companies.name: Datoric
companies.originalOneLiner: Security-first training data
companies.originalDescription: Datoric provides custom training data for voice models, robotics, and world models. We manage the full process from contributor recruitment and task design to secure collection, quality control, rights management, and delivery. Our collection infrastructure is private by design. Voice, robotics, and world-model projects run through separate applications and sites, so contributor pools, task requirements, incentives, and data flows do not mix across modalities. Within each system, customer projects are isolated in private workspaces. Only approved contributors can access assigned tasks, with no public task listings, upload links, or contributor APIs. We also build quality into the collection process instead of relying only on review after the data arrives. Contributors are qualified and matched before they participate, collection requirements are enforced inside each workflow, and early submissions are tested before a project scales. Every sample is then linked to its contributor, consent, usage rights, collection history, and review record. Datoric’s mission is to make human-generated training data more secure, reliable, and responsibly sourced from the moment it is created.
companies.story: 这家公司提供安全优先的训练数据服务，专门为语音模型、机器人和世界模型定制数据。想象你是一个研究工程师，需要收集大量高质量语音数据来训练一个语音助手，但担心数据隐私和合规问题。Datoric管理从贡献者招募、任务设计到安全收集、质量控制和交付的全过程。他们的基础设施是私有的，不同模态的项目完全隔离，客户项目也在私有工作空间里，只有批准的贡献者能访问。质量在收集过程中就内建了，而不是事后检查。这家公司来自YC夏季2026批次，团队两人，虽然很小，但解决的是人工智能发展中数据瓶颈的关键问题，值得关注。

companies.name: Flai
companies.originalOneLiner: We Bring Customers to Your Dealership
companies.originalDescription: The problem we solve: 56% of dealership leads arrive after business hours, and most dealers lose these potential customers to competitors who happen to be available 24/7. Missing after-hours calls alone costs the average dealership $1M annually in lost revenue. We built Flai to fix this - AI assistants that answer dealership calls 24/7, scheduling test drives, oil changes, or running outbound recall campaigns so no opportunity slips away. The result: No more missed opportunities, no more losing customers to competitors. Our founding team has built voice AI products at HappyRobot, scaled infrastructure at Uber for millions of users, and applied data science at Netflix to solve operational challenges. We're not just answering phones, we're helping dealerships win in an AI-first world where availability determine who gets the sale.
companies.story: 这是一家为汽车经销商提供人工智能语音助手的公司。想象你是一个经销商的销售经理，晚上六点后打来的电话占56%，但没人接，这些潜在客户往往就流失给了24小时在线的竞争对手。Flai的人工智能助手全天候接听电话，可以安排试驾、预约换油，甚至主动发起召回活动，确保没有机会溜走。据说，错过下班后的电话平均每年让一个经销商损失一百万美元。这家公司来自YC夏季2025批次，团队二十三人，正在招聘。创始团队有在Uber、Netflix和HappyRobot的背景，他们不只是接电话，而是帮经销商在人工智能优先的世界里赢得客户。

companies.name: Flick
companies.originalOneLiner: We Handle AI. You Direct Films.
companies.originalDescription: Flick is an AI filmmaking software that lets people create Hollywood-level short films completely using AI end-to-end. There are many AI tools that can give you 8-second casual clips to post on social media, but when it comes to creating truly high-quality films with coherent storylines, consistent characters, and cinematic aesthetics, they don’t come close due to their lack of flexibility, creative control, and fragmented creative flow. Founded by an award-winning filmmaker and a founding engineer at Instagram, Flick defines an interface specifically designed for native AI filmmaking that feels natural and enables end-to-end creative flows. Think of Flick as Figma for AI filmmaking. There are 4 complete AI short films created using Flick that got 20+ awards in international film festivals already and our early creator residency community are generating several AI short films every week. We are also building a community where we produce our own AI films as well as collaborating with other well-known filmmakers to share their “behind-the-scenes” workflows as resuable templates to inspire users in our community. We not only build product, we also build world-class content. The whole film industry will be revolutionized by AI and our goal is to be “the product” that defines this category.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是人工智能电影制作软件，让普通人也能用人工智能端到端创作好莱坞级别的短片。想象你是一个独立电影制作人，用现有的人工智能工具只能生成八秒钟的社交媒体片段，无法保持角色一致、故事连贯，创作流程也很碎片化。Flick提供专门为原生人工智能电影制作设计的界面，让你像用Figma一样自然地创作。创始人是获奖电影制作人和Instagram的创始工程师。他们用Flick制作的四部短片已经获得二十多个国际电影节奖项，早期创作者社区每周都在产出短片。这家公司来自YC秋季2025批次，团队两人，正在招聘。它把创作控制权交还给导演，而不是让人工智能随意生成。

companies.name: b12 Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: Making hard molecules for Pharma and Biotech
companies.originalDescription: b12 makes high-value molecules that are otherwise hard to make. We help pharma companies plan and make new drugs, accelerating early-stage drug discovery from years to months. Andres built the first AI agent that can autonomously think and make molecules in a robotic lab, published in Nature Machine Intelligence (1000+ citations), and won the best paper award at the NeurIPS AI for Science conference. Zlatko is a 3x National Chemistry Olympiad champion, competed at IChO level, and medicinal chemist who has worked at Roche and leading lab robotics companies. Combined, we have an extensive network of hundreds of chemists, automation scientists, and AI 4 Science researchers. We run paid pilots with big pharma companies, demonstrating that our platform planned a set of experiments that achieved full conversion in a single attempt, eliminating the iteration cycle.
companies.story: 这家公司为制药和生物技术公司制造难以合成的分子，加速早期药物发现。想象你是一个药物化学家，需要合成一个复杂的分子，传统方法可能要好几年，而且失败率高。b12实验室用人工智能智能体和机器人实验室自主设计并合成分子，发表在《自然机器智能》上的论文已被引用上千次，还获得NeurIPS人工智能科学会议最佳论文奖。创始人是化学奥林匹克奖牌得主，曾在罗氏工作。他们已经和大型制药公司开展付费试点，一次尝试就实现完全转化，消除了迭代周期。这家公司来自YC夏季2025批次，团队三人，正在招聘。它把人工智能和机器人结合，把药物发现的周期从几年缩短到几个月。

companies.name: Intelligence Factory
companies.originalOneLiner: Human Intelligence for Robots
companies.originalDescription: Robotics is the new paradigm. With hardware converging, Intelligence is the biggest bottleneck. Our world was built for humans and we're giving robots the ability to reason and act like us. The way we learn any task - by seeing, doing, and feeling - is how we train robots. We're building general intelligence that works on any robot and fits seamlessly within our world.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是机器人通用智能，让机器人像人类一样通过看、做和感受来学习任务。想象你是一个机器人工程师，你有一台人形机器人，但它只会执行预设程序，无法应对真实世界的复杂情况。Intelligence Factory训练机器人在人类环境中推理和行动，让它们适应我们建造的世界，而不是反过来。他们构建的智能可以适配任何机器人。这家公司来自YC春季2026批次，团队五人，正在招聘。随着硬件趋同，智能成为最大瓶颈，他们专注于解决这个问题。虽然还在早期，但方向很明确：让机器人真正融入我们的日常生活。

companies.name: Praxis AI
companies.originalOneLiner: Turns every company into a data vendor
companies.originalDescription: Praxis captures the data physical AI is bottlenecked on: egocentric video, 3D scans, and multimodal capture from inside real industrial and residential environments. Embedded within publicly listed and unicorn-scale conglomerates, we reach 60k workers across 5 continents and 150+ environment types, supplying the real-world training data frontier labs and humanoid companies can't source anywhere else.
companies.story: 这家公司为物理人工智能收集训练数据，包括第一人称视频、三维扫描和来自真实工业及家庭环境的多模态数据。想象你是一个数据采购经理，你需要大量真实世界数据来训练人形机器人，但很难找到多样化的环境。Praxis嵌入在上市公司和独角兽级别的企业集团中，覆盖五大洲六万名工人和一百五十多种环境类型，提供前沿实验室无法从其他地方获得的数据。这家公司来自YC夏季2026批次，团队三人。它把每家公司变成数据供应商，解决物理人工智能的数据瓶颈。这种模式很独特，因为它利用现有企业的规模来收集数据，而不是自己建立数据采集团队。

companies.name: Keye
companies.originalOneLiner: The Smartest Private Equity Investor
companies.originalDescription: Keye is an AI software that lets private equity firms do due diligence for acquisitions faster and more accurately. Our customers can evaluate 10x more deals and fund better companies which leads directly to better returns/more alpha. -- Our system is the first of its kind to instantly generate complex, comprehensive data packs from raw data in any format, directly from the data room. This enables investors to gain an 80% understanding of a potential deal within moments, empowering them to say No to a deal earlier in the process and focus on high-potential opportunities. Traditionally, creating these detailed data packs—like cohort or retention analyses and customer roll-forwards—takes weeks, during which critical details may be overlooked, potentially costing funds millions in missed insights and poor decisions. -- Keye combines cutting-edge AI with deep private equity expertise to deliver powerful, multi-layered insights that go far beyond the simple summarizers and search functions offered by other tools. Our platform dives deep into both quantitative and qualitative due diligence data, offering high-impact analytics crafted specifically for private equity workflows. This isn’t just automation—it’s a purpose-built solution that uncovers actionable insights, fueling smarter decisions and driving true alpha.
companies.story: 这家公司为私募股权公司提供人工智能尽职调查软件，让投资决策更快更准。想象你是一个私募股权分析师，需要在一个数据室里分析成千上万份文件，传统方法要几周才能生成一份客户留存分析报告，而且容易遗漏关键细节。Keye能瞬间从任意格式的原始数据生成复杂的数据包，让你在几分钟内了解一个交易的百分之八十，从而更早说“不”，专注于高潜力项目。这家公司来自YC秋季2024批次，团队三人，正在招聘。它结合了尖端人工智能和私募股权专业知识，让投资者能评估十倍多的交易，最终带来更好的回报。

companies.name: Eight Sleep
companies.originalOneLiner: Smart sleep hardware that adjusts bed temperature and tracks sleep.
companies.originalDescription: Eight Sleep makes connected sleep hardware that changes temperature through the night and uses sleep data to improve rest and recovery.
companies.story: 这是一家做智能睡眠硬件的公司，产品是智能床垫，可以整夜调节温度，并追踪睡眠数据来改善休息和恢复。想象你是一个睡眠质量差的上班族，每天醒来都感觉疲惫，试过各种手机应用但都没有实际效果。Eight Sleep的床垫内置传感器和温度调节功能，根据你的睡眠阶段自动调整温度，早上起来感觉更精神。它不只是一个手机应用，而是把能力放进床垫本身，因为温度调节和生物特征检测必须物理接触身体。这家公司来自智能硬件观察列表，目前没有招聘信息，但它的产品已经进入市场。对于追求健康的人来说，这种硬件方式比纯软件更直接有效。

readings.title: Show HN: Sous.bio – your sous chef in the lab
readings.story: 实验室里总有一堆重复的活儿：配溶液、算浓度、找试剂、记录数据，每一样都琐碎又容易出错。很多做实验的人其实都想过，要是能有个助手在旁边提醒就好了。这个叫 Sous.bio 的项目，名字就借了厨房里帮厨的意思，想给实验室也配一个这样的帮手。它出现在 Hacker News 上，说明是开发者自己做的，可能还比较早期。你可以带着一个问题去读：它到底把哪一步做成了自动化，是帮你查资料，还是帮你安排流程？看它怎么描述这个场景，就能判断它是不是真的懂实验室里的麻烦。

readings.title: OpenAI acquires presentation startup NextSlide
readings.story: 做演示文稿这件事，很多人觉得只是把内容排得好看一点。但真到要汇报、路演或者给客户提案的时候，你会发现排版和讲故事的功夫，往往比内容本身更花时间。OpenAI 收购一家做演示文稿的创业公司，听起来像是大公司买个小工具，但背后可能藏着更深的意图。如果你关心 人工智能 工具会怎样改变我们日常的工作方式，这篇值得一读。读的时候可以留意，作者是怎么把一次收购和整个行业的变化联系起来的，以及他提到的受益者，是不是真的能拿到好处。

readings.title: Backstory Retiered Its Entire Customer Base in 3 Days. The Same Exercise Used to Take Five Teams a Quarter.
readings.story: 很多做软件订阅的公司，都遇到过这样的头疼事：客户用着用着，套餐不合适了，得给他们重新分级。这活儿听起来简单，做起来却要协调好几个部门，常常一忙就是几个月。Backstory 这家公司居然三天就搞定了，而过去他们五个团队要忙一个季度。这种对比很吸引人，对吧？这篇文章讲的就是他们怎么做到的。读的时候，你可以特别留意他们到底改变了哪个环节，是用了新工具，还是换了思路，这比单纯看结果更有启发。

companies.name: Corelayer
companies.originalOneLiner: AI production engineer for regulated industries
companies.originalDescription: Corelayer is the AI-native platform for production software support, built for regulated industries like finance and healthcare. It continuously monitors alerts, logs, infrastructure, and underlying data for issues and uses agents to debug and suggest fixes. We're helping SRE, production services, and on-call engineers at companies ranging from growth-stage fintechs to Fortune 500 financial institutions spend less time on support and more on high-leverage work.
companies.story: Corelayer 是一家面向金融、医疗等受监管行业的人工智能生产支持平台。想象你是一家成长型金融科技公司的值班工程师，半夜被警报吵醒，日志、基础设施和数据里的问题让你焦头烂额。Corelayer 会持续监控这些信号，用智能体自动调试并给出修复建议，让你从繁琐的支持工作中解脱出来，把时间花在更有价值的事情上。它来自 YC 冬季批次，团队虽小，但瞄准的是财富五百强金融机构也在头疼的痛点，值得关注。

companies.name: Caution
companies.location: George Town, George Town, Cayman Islands
companies.originalOneLiner: Hosting platform for software you don't want to get hacked
companies.originalDescription: Caution is a hosting platform for software you can't afford to get hacked. It simplifies and extends confidential compute, and lets developers deploy workloads to secure enclaves in minutes and give customers, auditors, and counterparties cryptographic proof that production is running the exact reviewed source code, build, configuration, and runtime - not an opaque binary controlled by a cloud operator or internal admin. Confidential computing hardware exists, but the tooling is too fragmented and incomplete for most teams to use well. Today, attestation often proves only that a binary has a certain hash; it does not prove what source code produced that binary. Building the missing deployment, reproducibility, and verification layer requires specialized security engineering and often locks teams into one cloud or hardware stack. Caution turns that into a simple git-based workflow that builds reproducible enclave images, provisions infrastructure, and lets anyone independently verify what is running. We built Caution after years securing high-risk systems through Distrust, where we worked with hedge funds, custodians, blockchain teams, cloud platforms, and critical grid operators on systems responsible for more than $600B in assets. Again and again, the same problem showed up: teams running mission-critical infrastructure could not reliably prove what was executing in production. As AI, fintech, healthcare, and regulated data collaboration move into the cloud, "trust us" is no longer enough. Caution is a general-purpose platform: if it runs on a server, it can run verifiably on Caution. We're starting where trust failures cost the most, but we believe verifiable compute will become the default way software runs, the same way HTTPS became the default way it's served. Infrastructure you can verify, not trust.
companies.story: Caution 做的是面向安全敏感软件的托管平台，核心是简化机密计算。假如你是一家公司的安全负责人，要部署一个绝不能泄露密钥或用户数据的服务，传统方式既复杂又难以向审计方证明代码的真实性。Caution 让你用类似 git 的工作流，几分钟内把负载部署到安全飞地，并给出密码学证明，显示运行的就是你审查过的源码，而不是被云运营商控制的二进制。它来自 YC 夏季批次，团队五人，专门解决机密计算工具链碎片化的问题，让安全工程不再被锁定在单一云或硬件栈上。

companies.name: Soria
companies.originalOneLiner: AI Financial Research Terminal built for Healthcare (and beyond)
companies.originalDescription: Soria is an AI-native Financial Terminal for investors who specialize in a particular sector, starting with healthcare. Our agents convert hundreds of the most important public and private sources into an always-on financial model, reviewed by domain experts and delivered to hedge funds, banks, and asset managers through a terminal UI, MCP, API, warehouse sync, and research feed. Unlike our competitors, we own the data layer and expand bottom-up, one sector at a time - additionally our agents proactively do research on behalf of our clients without them lifting a finger or sharing any data.
companies.story: Soria 是一家专注医疗行业的人工智能金融研究终端。想象你是一家对冲基金负责医疗板块的分析师，每天要读几百份研报、会议记录和监管文件，手动更新财务模型。Soria 的智能体会自动把这些公开和私有来源整合成持续更新的财务模型，由领域专家审核后，通过终端界面、接口、数据仓库同步等方式送达到你手里。它来自 YC 春季批次，正在招聘，团队三人，自己拥有数据层，从医疗一个行业自下而上扩展，让投资者不用动手或分享数据就能获得主动研究。

companies.name: Tasklet
companies.originalOneLiner: Agents that own the work
companies.originalDescription: AI chatbots can answer questions, but they can't do your work — they aren't connected to your tools, can't take actions, and stop running when you close the tab. Meanwhile, knowledge workers are still spending most of their day switching between dozens of SaaS apps, manually stitching together workflows that should be automated. Tasklet is the AI agent that actually does the work. It connects to every tool you use — via thousands of built-in integrations, any HTTP API, or MCP servers — and takes real actions on your behalf: pulling reports, updating CRMs, triaging emails, processing data, and more. When it needs a UI, it generates one on the fly. When it needs to crunch numbers or do bulk operations, it writes and runs code in a cloud sandbox. When it needs to interact with a website that doesn't have an API, it uses a real browser. And because it runs in the cloud 24/7, you can set up triggers to have it take ongoing responsibility for workflows — not just do something once, but handle it going forward. The product is deliberately simple: a chat interface where you talk to an extremely capable agent. But underneath that simplicity is a cloud-native agent runtime, best-in-class context engineering, a universal connections layer, and multi-model support that keeps us on the frontier as AI improves. We think legacy SaaS is being unbundled by agents, and Tasklet is the operating system that ties it all together.
companies.story: Tasklet 做的是能真正干活的智能体，而不是只会聊天的机器人。想象你是一个运营主管，每天要在十几个 SaaS 应用之间切换，手动把报表、客户关系管理更新、邮件分类这些流程串起来。Tasklet 连接你用的所有工具，通过内置集成、接口或 MCP 服务器，替你执行实际操作：拉取报表、更新客户关系管理、处理邮件、处理数据。它需要界面时就现场生成，需要算数或批量操作时就写代码在云端沙箱运行，需要操作没有接口的网站时就用真实浏览器。因为它在云端 7x24 小时运行，你可以设置好任务让它持续工作。它来自 YC 春季批次，团队八人，正在招聘，解决的是知识工作者每天浪费大量时间在手动拼接工作流上的问题。

companies.name: Risklytics
companies.originalOneLiner: Commercial Insurance Brokerage for Frontier Tech
companies.originalDescription: Risklytics is a commercial insurance brokerage for frontier tech: robotics, autonomy, data centers, and energy infrastructure. Insurers are writing AI exclusions into standard liability forms, so companies whose products act in the physical world end up holding risk they thought they had transferred. We specialize in that gap, and we know which carriers in the admitted and surplus lines markets will still underwrite it. If you're building anything that moves, lifts, drives, or powers something, we'd like to talk.
companies.story: Risklytics 是一家面向前沿科技的商业保险经纪公司，专攻机器人、自动驾驶、数据中心和能源基础设施。想象你是一家自动驾驶公司的风险负责人，产品即将上路，却发现标准责任险里写入了人工智能免责条款，原本以为转移的风险其实还在自己手里。Risklytics 熟悉哪些保险公司在认可市场和超额市场仍愿意承保这类风险，帮你填补这个缺口。它来自 YC 夏季批次，团队两人，虽然规模小，但切中了物理世界产品面临的真实保险难题，值得关注。

companies.name: OctaPulse
companies.originalOneLiner: CV and robotics to automate quality inspection in fish farms
companies.originalDescription: OctaPulse uses AI vision to automate hatchery QA for fish farms, starting with broodstock phenotyping and juvenile deformity inspection. We cut inspection time from about 5 minutes to under 30 seconds per fish, with more than 90 percent accuracy, so farms advance only high quality fish and waste less feed and labor. Our goal is to bring automation across the entire fish production lifecycle for the $300B aquaculture industry. Aquaculture is the fastest growing food sector, and has already surpassed commercial fishing for production of seafood. Yet two of the most critical QA and QC steps in fish production are still done by hand: phenotyping and deformity inspection. These processes are slow, error prone, and despised by technicians but vital for the success of the farm, so much so that farms spend >$200K a year on trained technicians and geneticists to operate. We’ve built an AI vision platform for vertically integrated finfish farms that drops into existing workflows starting in the hatchery, uses off the shelf cameras, standardizes these QA steps, and creates a proprietary multi species dataset that becomes the brain for future autonomous aquafarms. Phenotyping is the start, but the platform is designed to be a drop in solution that can easily expand into feeding, health monitoring, and processing so we can solve production problems across the lifecycle. We signed a 6-figure paid pilot with the largest trout producer in the United States, are deploying into 2 more farms early 2026, and trained models above 90 percent accuracy while cutting inspection time from 5 minutes to under 30 seconds. Each deployment adds labeled images to our dataset and improves cross species generalization.
companies.story: OctaPulse 用计算机视觉和机器人技术自动检查鱼苗质量，面向水产养殖业。想象你是一家养鱼场的质检员，每天要手工给鱼做表型鉴定和畸形检查，每条鱼要花五分钟，又慢又容易出错，但这对鱼场成功至关重要。OctaPulse 把每条鱼的检查时间缩短到三十秒以内，准确率超过九成，让鱼场只保留优质鱼苗，节省饲料和人工。它来自 YC 冬季批次，团队两人，瞄准的是三千亿美元的水产养殖行业，这是增长最快的食品领域，而关键的质检环节仍靠人工，因此他们的自动化方案值得关注。

readings.story: 当你在网上购物、看视频或使用某个应用时，背后可能有一个巨大的数据中心在默默运行。这些设施耗电惊人，甚至可能成为当地最大的污染源。这篇报道讲的就是这样一个计划中的亚马逊数据中心，它可能会成为美国最大的气候污染者。读的时候，不妨想想：我们享受的便利服务，其成本究竟由谁承担？作者是如何呈现这个复杂问题的？

readings.title: 🧠 Community Wisdom: Crafting outreach that reads as authentic, finding design partners, what counts as a moat when anyone can build, making a product vision stick, and more
readings.story: 作为产品经理或创业者，你可能经常为如何找到第一批用户而发愁。写出去的邮件石沉大海，或者好不容易找到的设计伙伴并不合适。这篇社区智慧合集，汇集了很多人实战中的经验，比如怎样让沟通显得真诚，怎么判断什么是真正的护城河。读的时候，可以关注那些具体的小技巧，它们往往比宏大理论更管用。

readings.title: The Simple Math Behind a 3x Venture Fund: Why Your Best Investment Needs to Return the Whole Thing
readings.story: 风险投资听起来很神秘，但背后其实有简单的数学逻辑。为什么基金要追求高回报？为什么最好的那笔投资要能赚回整个基金？这篇文章用直白的方式解释了这些数字。如果你在创业或考虑融资，理解这些能帮你更好地和投资人沟通。读的时候，试着算一算，看看不同规模基金的投资策略有什么不同。

companies.name: Callab AI
companies.originalOneLiner: AI voice agents for on-prem telephony stack.
companies.originalDescription: 58% of the $400B call center industry runs on on-prem phone systems, and until now bringing AI voice automation to them meant ripping out their entire infrastructure first. That's the largest unserved segment in the market. Callab AI connects directly to legacy PBX systems like Avaya, Cisco UCM, and Mitel, and automates up to 70% of call volume with zero migration needed. We plug into these environments without requiring a rip-and-replace. We serve clients across three continents, including brands like Dunkin Donuts.
companies.story: 这是一家把人工智能语音助手接到老式电话系统上的公司。呼叫中心行业规模巨大，但一大半还在用本地部署的交换机，比如 Avaya、Cisco UCM 和 Mitel。假如你是呼叫中心的运营负责人，过去想引入人工智能自动化，往往得先把整套电话系统推倒重来，成本高、风险大，所以只能继续忍受人工接线。Callab AI 直接连到这些老系统上，不用迁移，就能自动处理多达七成的来电。它已经服务了三大洲的客户，包括 Dunkin Donuts 这样的品牌，说明这套方案在真实环境里跑得通。对于不想大动干戈又渴望提升效率的呼叫中心来说，这可能是最务实的切入点。

companies.name: ANORIA
companies.originalOneLiner: The first wearable that reads your emotions to enhance your EQ.
companies.originalDescription: We've spent decades tracking everything. Sleep. Recovery. Steps. All proxies for how we feel. Performance is 90% mental. And yet no one has built the feedback loop for our emotions. We close that loop by designing a device that understands how you feel, tells you why, and what you can do about it. Emotional intelligence becomes trainable, so you can better connect and create with those around you.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是能读懂情绪的可穿戴设备，方向是提升情商。我们平时用手环手表记录睡眠、步数，但这些只是身体状况的间接指标，真正影响表现的是心理状态，却一直缺少直接的反馈。想象你是一个经常需要演讲或谈判的职场人，每次紧张或烦躁时，自己往往意识不到，等察觉时已经影响了表现。ANORIA 的戒指或手环通过传感器捕捉情绪信号，告诉你此刻的感受、为什么会有这种情绪，以及可以怎么调整。这样一来，情商就变成可以训练的能力。它不只是一个手机应用，因为情绪信号需要贴身设备持续采集，才能给出及时反馈。

companies.name: Redouble AI
companies.location: New York City, NY, USA; Remote
companies.originalOneLiner: Java-native multi-agentic AI operating system for enterprise
companies.originalDescription: At Redouble AI we have developed Silverlake, a Java-native agentic AI operating system for enterprise. While other AI solutions force enterprise stakeholders to embrace unfamiliar concepts in an unfamiliar language, we do the opposite: we slot agentic AI right into the enterprise comfort zone - by mapping all agentic concepts onto established enterprise primitives in their own language, their own security model, their own infrastructure. It’s like moving from Bitcoin to Stablecoin, just for agentic AI. When we did YC we realized there was no framework or platform that gave us as enterprise and workflow automation veterans what we needed to build truly secure, reliable, and scalable agentic solutions for mission-critical workflows. That’s why we spent the past 18 months building Silverlake from the ground up. We empower the 12 million Java engineers worldwide to write and deploy their own AI, securely, at scale. They define an agent in a few lines of code, and our platform does everything else, from orchestration to permission control, from auditability to rate limiting, from long-running agents to autonomous coordinated networks that perform the work of entire departments. Silverlake has been developed with design partners across biopharma, insurance and financial services. For example, our agentic workflows write submission-ready Clinical Study Reports that are hundreds of pages long, analyze entire datarooms full of financial and operational data for private equity investors, and automate claims processing for a large insurance player. We are backed by Y Combinator, Exponential, Transpose Platform, Tiny VC, and the Oxford Seed Fund and advised by Java inventor James Gosling and automation guru Professor Christian Terwiesch.
companies.story: 这是一家做企业级人工智能操作系统的公司，核心产品叫 Silverlake，用 Java 开发。很多企业想把智能体引入核心流程，但现有方案往往要求他们接受陌生的概念和语言，很难落地。假如你是某家银行的系统架构师，面对的是严格的合规要求和老旧的 Java 系统，你希望人工智能能融入现有架构，而不是推翻重来。Redouble AI 把智能体的概念映射到企业熟悉的原语上，支持他们自己的安全模型和基础设施，让全球一千二百万 Java 工程师都能用熟悉的语言编写和部署智能体。它参加过 YC 夏季批次，团队虽然小，但都是企业自动化的老手，花了十八个月从头构建这个平台。

companies.name: screenpipe
companies.originalOneLiner: AI powered by everything you've seen, said or heard
companies.originalDescription: screenpipe record and learns how you work and turns it into a searchable memory, documents, and AI agents. Data is stored on your device or where your team choose, open source.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是记录你工作全过程的人工智能记忆工具。想象你是一个项目很多的咨询顾问，每天开无数个会、看大量文档、在 Slack 和 GitHub 之间切换，经常想找之前某次会议里提到的关键数字，却怎么也想不起来。screenpipe 会录制你在电脑上看到、说过和听到的内容，把它们变成可以搜索的记忆，还能生成文档和智能体。数据默认存在本地或团队指定的服务器上，而且是开源的，对隐私敏感的企业来说更有吸引力。它来自 YC 夏季批次，目前团队只有两个人，正在招聘，说明这个方向还处于早期，但想法很直接：让你拥有一个真正了解你工作的人工智能助手。

companies.name: Arctic Health
companies.originalOneLiner: AI-native credentialing and contracting for healthcare
companies.originalDescription: Arctic Health is building AI-native credentialing and contracting for healthcare organizations. We automate the full workflow, from establishing payer contracts to enrolling each provider. We collect and validate organization and provider data according to each state and payer’s requirements, and submit on the organization's behalf. We then monitor status and compliance on an ongoing basis. Tools on the market today either perform small pieces of the workflow or price out small and mid-sized organizations. We handle the process end-to-end regardless of organization type or size. Our browser automations enable AI agents to submit and monitor across hundreds of payer portals, and our system is trained by experienced industry experts who handle every edge case. Healthcare organizations get one simple platform. We handle the rest.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是医疗领域的认证和合同管理，用人工智能把整个流程自动化。假如你是医院或诊所的运营负责人，每次新增一个医生，都要和保险公司打交道，提交各种材料，还要按各州不同规则审核，过程繁琐又容易出错。Arctic Health 的系统会自动收集和验证机构及医生信息，按照各州和保险公司的要求提交申请，然后持续跟踪状态和合规情况。它用浏览器自动化，可以同时处理几百个保险门户网站，而且系统由资深行业专家训练，能应对各种边缘情况。现有的工具要么只做其中一小块，要么价格让小机构望而却步，它则端到端搞定，对各类规模的医疗机构都适用。

companies.name: Almond
companies.originalOneLiner: A dual-arm robot built for physical AI.
companies.originalDescription: We build robots for physical AI. Meet Axol - A dual-arm robot designed for real-world tasks using AI.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是双臂机器人，专门为物理人工智能设计。它的产品叫 Axol，看起来像一个小型的人形上半身，有两只灵活的机械臂，可以完成各种实际任务。想象你是一个实验室的研究员，经常需要重复搬运培养皿或整理器材，这些工作耗时又枯燥。Almond 的机器人可以通过人工智能学习这些任务，不需要复杂的编程。它来自 YC 春季批次，目前团队有六个人，正在招聘，说明还在快速发展。相比那些只能做单一任务的工业机械臂，它更接近通用机器人，未来可能进入更多场景。

companies.name: Nori
companies.originalOneLiner: Affordable robot you can teach to do anything
companies.originalDescription: Nori builds home robots that cost less than $2,000 and that anyone can teach. Out of the box, the NORI L3 does household chores: loading the dishwasher, folding laundry, tidying up. But because anyone can train it, it also learns your specific tasks, like washing paintbrushes if you're an artist or flipping sheet music while you play guitar. It's a general-purpose robot, not an appliance. We launched pre-orders 6 weeks ago and have already booked $100K in revenue. Humanoid robots exist, but they cost $20,000 or more and are demoed, not shipped. We got to $1,688 without sacrificing capability. Instead of expensive actuators, we use low-cost servos and get more out of them through smarter control and design. A wheeled base with a lift gives full floor-to-counter reach without the cost and fragility of legs, and we streamlined manufacturing from day one, assembling in the US. The teachability is the moat. Every skill a user trains can be shared, so each customer makes every robot more capable. Hardware is the entry point; the skill ecosystem is the recurring revenue. We're robotics researchers from Columbia labs like RoboPIL (robot learning) and CGUI. Working with $100K research robots that struggled with everyday tasks convinced us the problem isn't capability, it's cost. Good robots don't need to be expensive. Households already spend $2,000+ on single-task machines: a dishwasher, a washing machine, a vacuum. We sell one robot at $1,688 that does the work of all of them and learns more. At 5% of US households and $25 a month for skills, that's $2B a year in recurring revenue, on top of hardware.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是价格亲民、可以教它做任何事的家用机器人。它叫 Nori，售价不到两千美元，比那些动辄两万美元的人形机器人便宜很多。想象你是一个喜欢在家做手工的艺术家，每次用完画笔都要花时间清洗，Nori 可以学会这个任务，帮你洗画笔，甚至在你弹吉他时帮你翻乐谱。它出厂就能做洗碗、叠衣服、收拾房间这些家务，但更重要的是，任何人都可以训练它学习新任务。Nori 用轮子底座和升降结构，不用昂贵的腿部，所以成本低且更可靠。它已经开始接受预订，六周内就有一万美元收入，说明市场有真实需求。

companies.name: Dispatch
companies.originalOneLiner: Satellites for Manufacturing in Space
companies.originalDescription: Dispatch is building refurbishable reentry vehicles that host and return payloads for companies making ultra-high-value materials (semiconductors, biotech, and pharma) that can only be manufactured in space. Right now, these companies have no practical way to manufacture and get their products back to Earth. We solve this bottleneck. We just returned from the Mojave Desert testing our first full-scale reentry heat shield designed to protect the satellite as it returns from space at Mach 20+, built in an apartment for 100x cheaper than competitors. To test, we held it behind a rocket engine to simulate the forces of atmospheric reentry. IT WORKED! Watch here - https://youtu.be/dhlQmnIoptg To scale, we anchor permanent infrastructure in orbit - building high power Autonomous Space Stations designed from day one for "lights-out" manufacturing serviced by the reentry vehicles.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是可回收的再入飞行器，用于在太空制造高价值材料并送回地球。想象你是一家半导体公司的工程负责人，想在微重力环境下制造更完美的晶体，但苦于没有可靠且便宜的方式把产品带回来。Dispatch 正在测试他们的隔热罩，能承受以二十倍音速再入大气层的高温，而且他们是在公寓里造的，成本比竞争对手便宜一百倍。他们还在规划轨道上的自动化空间站，实现无人值守的制造。这个方向很前沿，但团队已经用火箭发动机模拟了再入环境，测试成功，说明技术有可行性。

companies.name: Lumius
companies.originalOneLiner: Fast, smart, accessible 3D ultrasound that anyone can use
companies.originalDescription: Ultrasound today is still mostly 2D. Clinicians have to imagine the 3D anatomy in their head while also moving the probe at the same time. This makes procedures like vascular access hard to learn and perform consistently, especially for beginners. ~50% fail on their first attempt. Hospitals also spend millions each year on 2D ultrasound training. Meanwhile, existing 3D ultrasound devices can cost >10× as much. Lumius is building fast, smart, and accessible 3D ultrasound systems to eliminate this 2D guesswork. Our technology shows a clear, real-time 3D view of what’s inside the body. It works over a large volume, not just a thin slice. The device is also affordable, compact, and portable. We are starting with vascular access, especially central line. Future use cases include blood clot detection, tumor diagnosis, and biopsy guidance. Our long-term vision is a universal 3D ultrasound platform that brings easy-to-use, real-time imaging to a wide range of clinical and eventually consumer applications.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是快速、智能且价格合理的 3D 超声设备。现在的超声大多是 2D 的，医生需要一边移动探头，一边在脑子里想象三维结构，这对新手来说很难，比如做中心静脉置管时，第一次尝试失败率高达百分之五十。假如你是急诊科医生，经常需要在紧急情况下快速找到血管，Lumius 的设备能直接显示清晰的三维图像，而且覆盖体积大，不是只显示一个切面。它比传统 3D 超声便宜很多，体积小，便携。他们从血管通路开始，未来可能用于血栓检测、肿瘤诊断和活检引导。

companies.name: Oura
companies.originalOneLiner: Smart ring for sleep, readiness, and health tracking.
companies.originalDescription: Oura builds a smart ring that collects sleep and body signals, then helps users understand recovery, readiness, and longer-term health patterns.
